meta.title: Trailblaze - AI Consulting for Modern Teams
meta.description: Trailblaze helps teams adopt AI in their daily work, engineering first, with experts for design, product and sales when you need them.

hero.headline: Make AI the way work gets done.
hero.sub: From engineering to design, product and sales, we help your teams turn AI from novelty into the way work gets done. Hands-on, on your real workflows, with the people who actually do the job.

about.heading: AI expertise is built on real work.
about.p1: AI tools change every week. Every person on your team deserves to get the most out of them, and that expertise only comes from practice on real work, with the right guidance alongside.
about.p2: Trailblaze helps teams adopt the best AI practices and maximise the return on their AI investment. Engineering is where we go deepest, and we bring dedicated experts for design, product, and marketing/sales when the work calls for it.

approach.heading:
Two things,
done well.
approach.desc: We work directly with your team, on real code and real workflows. No artificial exercises.

p1.title: Hands-on workshops
p1.desc: Small groups of 2 to 4 people, working on your actual codebase and tools. Reproducible best practices, calibrated to each participant's level of AI experience. People leave with habits, not slides.

p2.title: Prompt reviews
p2.desc: We analyse how AI is actually being used in your team's day-to-day work, hand back targeted recommendations they can apply immediately, and track how the practice evolves week after week.

tools.heading:
The instruments
we bring with us.
tools.desc: Software we've built, and continue to build, to make adoption measurable and the workflow specifically yours.

t1.title: Adoption & velocity dashboard
t1.desc: Tracks AI adoption across the team and the impact on delivery velocity, so progress is visible and decisions can be made on data.

t2.title: Prompt logging & reporting
t2.desc: Captures what people are actually prompting and producing, so reviews and recommendations are grounded in real practice, not anecdotes.

t3.title: Custom-built tools
t3.desc: When a workflow needs its own tooling, we design and build it for you, fitted to how your business actually operates.

process.heading:
How an engagement
usually goes.
process.desc: Every company is different, but the shape of the work tends to follow these four steps.

step1.title: Assess
step1.desc: We sit with your team to understand how AI is being used today, where the gaps are, and what's actually slowing people down.

step2.title: Practice
step2.desc: Hands-on workshops on your real code, in small groups, with content tuned to each person's level.

step3.title: Iterate
step3.desc: Weekly code and prompt reviews, with targeted recommendations and visible progress tracking.

step4.title: Scale
step4.desc: Once it works, we help you spread the practice and grow internal champions, so you don't need us forever.

caseStudy.heading:
Same team.
Different output.
caseStudy.desc: An engineering team we worked with over 16 months. Headcount stayed flat. The way they shipped changed completely.

chart1.title: Cumulative code output
chart1.subtitle: Functional code only. Team size held constant.

principles.heading: Why us.
principles.desc: A lot of firms talk about AI. Here's what's actually different about working with us.

p1.title: We use what we teach
p1.desc: We've been running 100% AI-driven development since early 2025. Every recommendation we give is something we use ourselves, every day, on real production work.

p2.title: Veteran AI-first practitioners
p2.desc: Our people are CTOs, CPOs, and very senior ICs. Every one of them has been shipping production code AI-first, every day, for over a year.

p3.title: Engineering core, full-stack ready
p3.desc: Engineering is where we go deepest, and we bring dedicated experts for design, product, and marketing/sales when your work calls for them.

backupta.desc: Backupta builds secure, automated backup solutions for businesses. We helped every team shift to AI-first workflows and built custom AI-powered tools that now run across their entire operation.

lyvoc.desc: Lyvoc is a cybersecurity integration partner deploying Okta, Drata and Vanta across Europe. We trained their teams to work with AI at every level and developed bespoke tools that accelerate how they deliver for clients.

alma.desc: Alma is a leading European payments company, providing instalment and pay-later solutions across the continent. We work with their engineering teams to embed AI deeply into how they design, build, and ship.

contact.heading:
Ready to blaze
the trail?
contact.sub: If you're thinking about how AI fits into how your teams work, let's talk.
